digo_source: Mgombato; Pakia (varieties nanasi ra baka, nanasi ra chidigo)

teaser.en: Each pineapple plant puts all its effort into a single fruit, perched on top of a rosette of spiny leaves.
teaser.sw: Kila mmea wa nanasi huweka nguvu zake zote katika tunda moja, lililokaa juu ya shada la majani yenye miiba.
teaser.dg: Chila mmea wa nanasi unaika nguvuze zosi kpwenye tunda mwenga, ambaro ri dzulu ya makodza genye miya ganayozunguluka phamwenga.

summary.en: *Nanasi* is the pineapple, grown on farms along the south coast for its sweet, juicy fruit. Digo growers distinguish a local variety from others.
summary.sw: *Nanasi* ni nanasi, linalolimwa mashambani katika pwani ya kusini kwa ajili ya tunda lake tamu lenye maji mengi. Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina ya kienyeji na aina nyingine.
summary.dg: *Nanasi* (kpwa Chingereza *pineapple*) nkurimwa minda ya pwani ya kusini kpwa sababu ya tundare ra mtswano renye madzi manji. Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina ya chienyeji na aina zanjina.

about.en:
The pineapple is a low, spiny rosette of stiff, sword-shaped leaves, often edged with small sharp teeth. From the centre a single stalk rises carrying a cone of purple flowers, which fuse together into one fruit topped by a tuft of leaves.

Each plant bears one main fruit at a time. When ripe, the fruit is golden and fragrant.
about.sw:
Mnanasi ni shada fupi lenye miiba la majani magumu yenye umbo la upanga, ambayo mara nyingi huwa na meno madogo makali pembeni. Kutoka katikati huchipuka kikonyo kimoja kinachobeba koni ya maua ya zambarau, ambayo huungana kuwa tunda moja lenye kishungi cha majani juu yake.

Kila mmea huzaa tunda moja kuu kwa wakati mmoja. Likiiva, tunda huwa la rangi ya dhahabu na lenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg:
*Nanasi* ni mmea mfupi wenye miya, wa makodza mafu ganayozunguluka phamwenga. Makodza higa ni dza upanga, na manji gana meno madide makali kanda-kanda. Kula kahi-kahi mlita mmwenga unakpweza dzulu, na una maruwa ga zambarau ganayokala phamwenga dza koni. Maruwa higa ganagbwirana na kukala tunda mwenga, na dzulu ya tunda hiro kuna kundi ra makodza madide.

Chila mmea nkulavya tunda mwenga dzikulu kpwa wakati mmwenga. Richiivwa, tunda rinakala ra rangi ya zahabu, na rina mzingo.

where.en: Pineapples are grown on farms on the south coast.
where.sw: Mananasi hulimwa mashambani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Manasi nkurimwa minda ya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh and pressed for juice.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa likiwa bichi na hukamuliwa sharubati.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa dza ririvyo, na nkubanwa ili kulavya madzi ga kunwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *nanasi*, the same as in Swahili. Growers distinguish *nanasi ra baka* from *nanasi ra chidigo*, the Digo pineapple. In English it is pineapple. Mgombato records it under the older scientific name *Ananas sativus*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *nanasi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Wakulima hutofautisha *nanasi ra baka* na *nanasi ra chidigo*, nanasi la Kidigo. Kwa Kiingereza linaitwa *pineapple*. Mgombato inaliorodhesha kwa jina la kisayansi la zamani *Ananas sativus*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *nanasi*, sawa na Chiswahili. Akurima anatafwautisha *nanasi ra baka* na *nanasi ra chidigo*, nanasi ra Chidigo. Kpwa Chingereza rinaihwa *pineapple*. Mgombato anariandika kpwa dzina ra kare ra sayansi, *Ananas sativus*.

reason.en: Another tropical fruit grown on coastal farms
reason.sw: Tunda lingine la kitropiki linalolimwa katika mashamba ya pwani
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra tsi za dzoho rinarorimwa minda ya pwani.

reason.sw: Tunda lingine la shambani lenye maji mengi
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra minda renye madzi manji.

reason.en: Another fruit with named Digo varieties
reason.sw: Tunda lingine lenye aina zenye majina ya Kidigo
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina renye aina zenye madzina ga Chidigo.

reason.en: Another fruit with local Digo cultivars
reason.sw: Tunda lingine lenye aina za kienyeji za Kidigo
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina renye aina za chienyeji za Chidigo.
